notes: The story («أتى أنس ثابت بن قيس ... فقال هكذا عن وجوهنا») is a narrated encounter in which Thabit speaks and acts; whether he is a link or only in the scene is a ruling, so needs_ruling is true (rule 11).
«رواه حماد عن ثابت عن أنس» names a different transmitter for the same saying: a variant group, not a route.
